both_sources_speak.note: where the EPC and the cross-reference each name exactly one family, this many disagree; a disagreement is pooled and flagged rather than trusted to either source

familyResolution.rule: one table, two sources — 01_data/00_derived/vehicle_family_bands.csv, written by 03_analytics/Isuzu/prism/scripts/build_vehicle_family_bands.py. A part is placed when every source that names a vehicle for it agrees; a part that fits more than one family is pooled and never apportioned; a wildcard model code still names a family but is recorded at medium confidence.

notAttempted: A 3.5 t versus 7.5 t split. 50 of 120 model codes in prism/data/model_code_to_tonnage.csv are unresolved and the unresolved ones include NN, NP and NHR — exactly the codes that separate N35 from N75. Splitting on them would be inference, so the N-series is reported as one family.

A fuel-filter answer by family. Fuel filters are the second-largest service family and almost none of their billing resolves to one vehicle family: the two decoded part numbers fit both the N-series and the heavy models, and the remaining part numbers in that family have no vehicle reference at all. The fuel-filter euro therefore sits in the pooled value, not in a family.

An oil-filter answer by family. Oil filters are the largest service family by units and their part numbers are shared across the truck families and the industrial engines, so the same pooled treatment applies.

tie1.basis: sum of the three named families against pms_capture_by_db_year.csv line_type=total expected_qty; the pooled shared value is the same ceiling and is excluded from the sum

BELGIUM.note: JP VIN register destination BE: 49 shipments, NLR 42 (all 3.5 t) -> 42/49 = 0.8571. The previous 0.918 read 45/49 but the register holds 42 NLR, 3 NMR (5.5 t), 4 NPR (7.5 t) and no F. Corrected 2026-09-18. Sample is small (49) but the vehicles in service is almost all D-Max (LCV 9,480 vs cv_std 113) so the effect is immaterial either way.

CYPRUS.note: Unmeasured. JP VIN register destination CY holds 114 shipments and ZERO at 3.5 t: NPR 7.5 t 60, NNR 6.5 t 48, NMR 5.5 t 6. NMR is not an N35 (N35 = NLR/NMR 3.5 t only). There is no parc basis for Cyprus. The current rate is kept rather than guessing; a measured or distributor-confirmed figure is needed before this market is split.

GERMANY.note: Confirmed. Helwig Schmitt parc overview at 31/12/2025 (mail 2026-06-11 from Sebastian Mueller; on disk 01_data/90_INBOX/_isd_std_mail_20260818/attachments/2026-06-11_ISD_Fahrzeugbestand_-_Basis_-_Uebersicht_D_.xlsx): Nfz 787 = <=3.40 t 25 + 3.41-3.50 t 153 + 3.51-5.50 t 79 + 5.51-6.50 t 147 + 6.51-7.50 t 318 + 7.51-12.0 t 35. The 3.41-7.50 t block is 697 and 153/697 = 0.2195, so 0.220 stands.

GREECE.note: Confirmed zero. JP VIN register destination GR holds 4 shipments: NMR85 2 (5.5 t) and NPR75 2 (7.5 t). No 3.5 t truck at all, and cv_std is 37 units. Nothing to split.

IRELAND.note: SIMI national registrations (01_data/07_UIO/isuzuregdata.xlsx sheet Sheet2, 2010-2025) convolved against the ISZE scrap-adjusted CV curve, evaluated at 2025: N35 464 of N35+N75 1,502 = 0.3089. Flow basis for reference: 663/1,963 = 0.3377; 663/(663+1300+122) = 0.3180. Basis is the parc, because the split is applied to a parc. The previous 0.063 was NOT the SIMI number: it is 36/570 from the JP VIN register (IE), which is a shipment flow of 647 trucks. Fixed 2026-09-18.

ITUK.note: Confirmed. Live read from the UIO workbook sheet '2. Vehicle Volume' section B: N35 10,900 of 21,584 N-series. The live read always overrides this value.

MALTA.note: Unmeasured. JP VIN register destination MT holds 130 shipments: NPR75 73, NMR88 / NMR85 48, FRR 9. NMR88 is a 9.5 t truck, not a 3.5 t N35, so the NMR-class count is NOT evidence of a 3.5 t parc. The previous 0.369 rested on reading 48 NMR as N35. No parc basis exists for Malta. The current rate is kept rather than guessing.

PORTUGAL.note: Confirmed. Official I-Motors registrations (01_data/07_UIO/Matriculas Isuzu SAP.xlsx) convolved with the UIO V19 survival curve in 01_data/08_Distributor/Imotors_Portugal_UIO_GPS_PMS_Study.xlsx sheet UIO_Rebuild. 2025 N-series parc: N35 1,521.31 + N75/N50/N62 869.00 = 2,390.31; light share 1,521.31/2,390.31 = 0.6364. (2024 = 0.6386.) Replaces the 2026-09-18 JP shipment mix 0.6899 (NLR 1,299/1,883). units_2025e stays the workbook LD row (2,206); the study rebuilt stock is 2,390 — fleet-base swap is a separate decision.

UTI.note: Confirmed zero. 2,360 distinct CV claim VINs (Dec 2023-Mar 2026): NPR75 895, FRR90 817, FSR90 627, and zero NLR/NMR/NKR. The Israeli Ministry of Transport band table starts at 6.5-7.5 t. No 3.5 t truck exists in the market.
